values.catalogue:
High-Bandwidth Smart Factory Connectivity — Suitable for smart manufacturing environments requiring reliable Gigabit connectivity between machines, HMIs, and industrial control systems.
Multi-Site Enterprise Network Extension — Can be deployed across branch offices, warehouses, and distributed facilities to provide secure cellular backup and centralized network management.
Smart Energy & Utility Field Automation — Can be deployed in substations, solar plants, and utility networks to collect real-time field data and enable remote diagnostics through cellular connectivity.
